title: lonicera korolkowii var. zabelii
intro: Lonicera korolkowii var. zabelii, commonly known as the Zabel's honeysuckle, is a plant species belonging to the Caprifoliaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and providing antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Zabel's honeysuckle include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
